timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Get it folks, Camping Camp here from EasyTrail. I'm here today to show you our most popular
Ford Fold camper, the Sterling GT Mark III. Now the reason this camper is so popular,
because it really is the complete package and it's quick and easy to set up. The Sterling
GT was always built tough for off-road adventure, but this new generation Mark III model takes
it to the next level. The rock solid F5 chassis and drawbar are made from hot dip galvanized
Q345 steel and an engine certified for off-road use. We're so confident in the F5 chassis
and drawbar we're giving buyers a lifetime warranty for on and off-road use. That's an
industry first folks and just one more reason you can feel confident buying an EasyTrail.
The Sterling GT Mark III wants to take you way off-road. It comes with EasyTrail's proven
independent suspension system that is not just tough, it also is fully adjustable from
its solid swing arms through to the comfortable coil springs and twin shock absorbers. The
Sterling GT Mark III really is built to go anywhere. And once you get to that hidden campsite,
you'll be totally self-sufficient. The Sterling GT Mark III has two 100 amp-hour batteries
and can carry 155 litres of fresh water. Plus there's the option for a built-in hot water
system that means piping hot water straight to your kitchen and shower. The master control
panel that shows battery usage and water levels is now conveniently located at the kitchen.
The on-suite tent is a modular design that can be set up independently or adjacent to
the massive awning, which comes with a full set of walls and PVC floor to create a huge
fully sealed anix. Like the main tent, it's made from tough yet lightweight 450 GSM fine-weave canvas.
There's a fully lockable integrated front toolbox with three compartments to keep your gear
organised and safe. When it comes to cooking up a camping feast, this slide out kitchen
is a beauty. Not only does it have a huge four-burner stove and loads of storage with a separate
pantry drawer and fridge slide, but the kitchen slide has a CNC cable tray installed for permanent
water connection. So there's no need to fiddle with hoses at the camp. Moving inside the sterling
GT Mark III is as luxurious as forward fold campers come. The higher body sides on the Mark III
makes the internal lounge that much more comfortable and it makes it easier to pack away the canvas.
There's a comfy queen-sized bed with a triple-hyde density mattress, no need for mattress
toppers, plenty of LED lighting and loads of storage. There's even the option to add a diesel
heated to keep your toasty warm at the cooler campsites. So folks, if you're looking for
a camper trailer that makes off-road adventure simple yet comfortable, come into your local
easy trail showroom to check out the sterling GT Mark III. I reckon you'll love it.

Check out Camping Cam as he walks through the Stirling GT MK3

When your priority is a quick getaway, and a super-fast set-up time when you get to your destination, Ezytrail’s Stirling GT MK3 is an off-road family camper-trailer that does the lot, making it the number one selling camper-trailer in the market.
